title: The Arrow of Fire
subtitle: A Mysterious Journey Ignites in Kashmir
summary: When a sudden proposal to travel to Kashmir stirs tempers and questions, Byomkesh finds himself at the crossroads of curiosity and necessity. As financial woes tangle with hidden motives, a new mystery crackles to life—one that only the legendary detective can unravel. Step into a world where every conversation could be the first clue.
